title: MSFS Marketplace Update (Feb 7): New C‑32, AC‑130J & 1500R Sport Land in the Hangar!
description:
🔍 Description

February 7 brings another exciting Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update, and this week’s lineup adds some seriously must‑have aircraft for PC pilots. From the sleek 1500R Sport to the heavy‑hitting AC‑130J, this week is packed with variety and fun.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:
🛫 Emerald Scenery Design: 1500R Sport (Light sport aircraft, great for low‑and‑slow flying)
🛫 mscenery: C‑32 Professional (A VIP transport variant of the Boeing 757)
🛫 Captain Sim: AC‑130J Ghost Rider (Heavy gunship variant, now available on PC)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:
🎨 Captain Sim: AC‑130J Livery Pack 1 (A set of themed liveries for the Ghost Rider)

If you enjoyed this breakdown, feel free to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly updates, and drop a comment sharing which aircraft you’re picking up!

✈️ See you in the skies!
